correctness.rationale: All finite multipath face sets have two independent full enumerations. The complete Hasse graph of each case is checked for acyclic matching; signed integer critical-cell differentials are recomputed from every gradient path. A rank-one Smith invariant 2 for m=3,4,5 and zero boundary at m=6 yield the claimed CW homotopy types using π1(S1)=Z and π2(∨S2)=Z^r. Finite-field homology in characteristics 2,3,5 is separately verified. Proof applies to exactly four specified finite graphs.

value.rationale: Triangular books are the minimal edge-sharing cycles, extending single-polygon directed multipath questions to natural overlapping cycles. Their exact integral CW homotopy types show a characteristic-two torsion degree shift H1 to H2 and its absence at the next computed page count, invisible to rational homology or one-field ranks. Four successive structurally canonical cases supply a meaningful rigorous finite classification, without implying a general threshold.
